app.title: Kundali
app.description: Transparent Vedic Astrology, Computed Then Interpreted

userWorkspace.tagline: Every number is computed. Every claim is cited. Every reading can be checked.
userWorkspace.disclaimer: Astronomical positions are computed deterministically; traditional interpretive meanings are not scientifically proven to predict events and are offered for reflection and cultural exploration.
userWorkspace.bsDisplayPending: BS display formatting awaits backend bikram_sambat.py implementation.
userWorkspace.scopeDashaOnly: Dasha-only change: updates Vimshottari year_days without recomputing planetary positions.
userWorkspace.scopeFullChart: Chart change: recomputes sidereal ChartFacts and dependent Dasha/Transits.
userWorkspace.sampleBannerBody: Generated directly by the deterministic calculation engine (2015-05-15 14:30 Europe/London, Lahiri, Whole Sign, Mean Node). Not personal birth data and not an independent third-party reference.
userWorkspace.approxBannerBody: This profile uses an approximate birth time. Lagna and whole-sign house placements remain sensitive to clock-time uncertainty (tracked independently from the 0.5° Lagna boundary check).
userWorkspace.unknownTimeBannerTitle: Unknown Birth Time — Moon-Based Mode Only
userWorkspace.unknownTimeBannerBody: No arbitrary clock time is substituted. Lagna, f_lagna_sensitivity, and whole-sign houses (1–12) are suppressed. Moon-boundary checks over the complete local civil birth-date interval in the profile's IANA timezone await backend implementation; boundary detection is not claimed here.
userWorkspace.awaitingBsBody: This profile was entered in Bikram Sambat (BS). Accurate BS-to-AD conversion awaits backend bikram_sambat.py implementation; no ad-hoc frontend conversion is performed.
userWorkspace.awaitingApiBody: Chart calculation endpoint (/profiles/{id}/chart) is currently a backend stub; no frontend placement values are fabricated.
userWorkspace.awaitingRecomputeBody: Calculation settings changed to non-snapshot values; recomputation awaits backend /profiles/{id}/chart integration (planetary positions are never fabricated client-side).
userWorkspace.dashaOnlyNotice: Updated Dasha year length convention without recomputing planetary positions.
userWorkspace.tableCaption: Sidereal planetary placements and Lagna from ChartFacts
userWorkspace.tableEmptyNotice: Planetary house placements are unavailable without resolved ChartFacts or when birth time is unknown.
userWorkspace.authRequiredBannerTitle: Authentication Required to Manage Saved Profiles
userWorkspace.authRequiredBannerBody: No active session token is present. Login and registration UI will be delivered in the separate authentication milestone. Persistent profile creation, editing, and deletion are disabled; you may still inspect the illustrative synthetic sample.
userWorkspace.authFormLockedNotice: Authentication required: saving or updating profiles via /api/v1/profiles is disabled until a valid access token is provided.
userWorkspace.deleteConfirmPrompt: Permanently delete this saved birth profile? Its encrypted birth date, time, place, and coordinates will be removed immediately.
userWorkspace.savedProfileChartPendingTitle: Saved Birth Profile — Chart Calculation Pending
userWorkspace.chatContractBody: When app/ai/* and /charts/{id}/chat are implemented, the LLM receives only allowlisted derived facts and retrieved knowledge chunks—never ChartMetadata timestamps, Julian Day, coordinates, or raw birth details.
userWorkspace.chatAllowlistTitle: Allowlisted Payload Preview (derived facts + conventions only)
userWorkspace.chatExcludedList: ChartMetadata (datetime_utc_iso, julian_day, utc_offset_hours), birth_profiles raw dates/times, latitude, longitude, timezone, and user identity.
userWorkspace.dashaContractBody: Three-level drill-down (Mahadasha → Antardasha → Pratyantardasha) awaiting backend app/calc/dasha.py implementation. No period dates are fabricated.
userWorkspace.dashaHierarchyLabel: Hierarchy: All MD > MD > AD > PD
userWorkspace.transitsContractBody: Current planetary transits relative to natal Lagna/Moon and upcoming sign ingresses await backend app/calc/transits.py and /charts/{id}/transits implementation.
userWorkspace.unavailableNoChart: Unavailable until verified ChartFacts are loaded for a known birth time.
userWorkspace.formSubtitle: Store the original birth-date calendar separately from your display preference. Unknown birth times never substitute a guessed clock time.
userWorkspace.formLabelPlaceholder: e.g., Personal Chart or Family Member
userWorkspace.formTimeUnknownNote: Time disabled: unknown birth time omits local clock time and suppresses Lagna/houses.
userWorkspace.formPlacePlaceholder: Enter city, district, or locality explicitly
userWorkspace.formCoordinatesNote: Enter decimal coordinates and a canonical region-based IANA timezone manually. Coordinates are never inferred from the place name until a geocoding provider is approved.
